cards.name: Bricks
cards.summary: Brick wall texture. It first builds a small tile in a temporary document (a 144 x 72 unit tile at 150 ppi): grey noise base, a 72 x 36 brick rectangle filled red-brown (hue 13, saturation 81%, brightness 70%), Clouds, Fade 50%, a 5 px centred stroke for the mortar, Spatter and noise, then copies the brick with offsets to stagger the rows.
